items.title: Mixed industry concern over potential tax relief changes for UK investment
items.summary: A Professional Pensions survey reveals split opinion on whether upcoming Budget tax relief changes could be used to mandate pension scheme investment in UK assets.

items.title: NAIC reports growth in US domestic cyber insurance market
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, u.S. domestic direct premiums written for cyber insurance reached nearly $7.5 billion in 2025, while endorsement policies accounted for the majority of policies in force.

items.title: Investment tax relief growth slows to £1.1bn in 2025/26
items.summary: Tax breaks for UK savings and investments recorded their smallest increase in four years, according to research from Bowmore Financial Planning published by Investment Week.

items.title: Munich Re and Africa Finance Corporation launch $1bn debt mobilisation programme
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, global reinsurer Munich Re and the Africa Finance Corporation have established a programmatic credit risk-sharing facility to support trade finance liquidity across Africa.

items.title: Professional Pensions schedules webinar on UK infrastructure investment
items.summary: According to Professional Pensions, online session held in association with Gravis to explore public and private asset routes for pension schemes.

items.title: Anthropic IPO highlights AI liability risks and capacity concerns for insurers
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, morningstar DBRS warns that catastrophic artificial intelligence liabilities could exceed industry capacity as Anthropic files for a US stock market listing.
